## 1. Nepal Income Tax Slabs & Calculation Formula (FY 2083/84)
- Canonical URL: https://nepalicalc.com/tax
- Applicable Legal Authority: Inland Revenue Department (IRD), Nepal Finance Act FY 2083/84
- Base Social Security Exemption: 1% Social Security Tax on first Rs 10,00,000 is waived (0%) if employee is registered with the Social Security Fund (SSF) under SSF Act.

### Natural Person (Individual / Single) Tax Slabs:
| Slab No. | Taxable Income Range (NPR) | Tax Rate (Non-SSF) | Tax Rate (SSF Registered) | Max Tax in Band (NPR) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Band 1 | First NPR 10,00,000 | 1% | 0% (Exempt) | NPR 10,000 (Rs 0 with SSF) |
| Band 2 | Next NPR 5,00,000 (10L - 15L) | 10% | 10% | NPR 50,000 |
| Band 3 | Next NPR 10,00,000 (15L - 25L) | 20% | 20% | NPR 2,00,000 |
| Band 4 | Next NPR 15,00,000 (25L - 40L) | 27% | 27% | NPR 4,05,000 |
| Band 5 | Above NPR 40,00,000 | 29% | 29% | No upper limit |

### Married Couple Tax Slabs:
| Slab No. | Taxable Income Range (NPR) | Tax Rate (Non-SSF) | Tax Rate (SSF Registered) | Max Tax in Band (NPR) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Band 1 | First NPR 10,00,000 | 1% | 0% (Exempt) | NPR 10,000 (Rs 0 with SSF) |
| Band 2 | Next NPR 5,00,000 (10L - 15L) | 10% | 10% | NPR 50,000 |
| Band 3 | Next NPR 10,00,000 (15L - 25L) | 20% | 20% | NPR 2,00,000 |
| Band 4 | Next NPR 15,00,000 (25L - 40L) | 27% | 27% | NPR 4,05,000 |
| Band 5 | Above NPR 40,00,000 | 29% | 29% | No upper limit |

### Legal Deductions:
- Citizen Investment Trust (CIT) / Employees Provident Fund (EPF): Lower of actual contribution, 1/3 of total assessable income, or NPR 5,00,000.
- Life Insurance Premium: Lower of actual annual premium or NPR 40,000.
- Medical / Health Insurance: Lower of actual premium or NPR 20,000.
- Female Tax Credit: 10% direct tax rebate on total calculated tax for resident female wage earners.

## 2. Nepal Land Measurement Units & Exact Conversions
- Canonical URL: https://nepalicalc.com/land
- Cadastral Survey Standards: Department of Survey (नापी विभाग)

### Hill & Kathmandu Valley System:
- 1 Ropani = 16 Aana = 64 Paisa = 256 Daam = 5,476.00 Square Feet = 508.737 Square Meters
- 1 Aana = 4 Paisa = 16 Daam = 342.25 Square Feet = 31.796 Square Meters
- 1 Paisa = 4 Daam = 85.5625 Square Feet = 7.949 Square Meters
- 1 Daam = 21.390625 Square Feet = 1.987 Square Meters

### Terai (Plain) System:
- 1 Bigha = 20 Kattha = 400 Dhur = 72,900.00 Square Feet = 6,772.63 Square Meters
- 1 Kattha = 20 Dhur = 3,645.00 Square Feet = 338.63 Square Meters
- 1 Dhur = 182.25 Square Feet = 16.93 Square Meters
- 1 Kanwa = 1/16 Dhur = 11.39 Square Feet

### Cross-System Mathematical Conversion Constants:
- Bigha to Ropani: 1 Bigha = 13.3126 Ropani
- Ropani to Bigha: 1 Ropani = 0.0751 Bigha
- 1 Kattha = 10.65 Aana
- 1 Aana = 1.878 Dhur

## 3. Commercial Banks Loan Base Rates & Lending Guidelines (NRB)
- Canonical URL: https://nepalicalc.com/emi/banks
- Regulatory Authority: Nepal Rastra Bank (NRB) Monetary Policy Directives

### Bank Base Rate League Table (Current Fiscal Period):
1. Rastriya Banijya Bank (RBB): 6.95% Base Rate
2. Nepal Bank Limited (NBL): 7.10% Base Rate
3. Standard Chartered Bank Nepal (SCB): 7.15% Base Rate
4. Nabil Bank Limited (NABIL): 7.35% Base Rate
5. Everest Bank Limited (EBL): 7.40% Base Rate
6. Sanima Bank Limited (SANIMA): 7.55% Base Rate
7. NMB Bank Limited (NMB): 7.60% Base Rate
8. Global IME Bank Limited (GBIME): 7.68% Base Rate
9. Siddhartha Bank Limited (SBL): 7.72% Base Rate
10. Himalayan Bank Limited (HBL): 7.75% Base Rate
11. Prabhu Bank Limited (PRVU): 7.85% Base Rate
12. NIC Asia Bank Limited (NICA): 7.92% Base Rate

### Essential Lending Directives:
- **Debt Service to Income (DSTI / DBR)**: 50% max limit. Total combined monthly debt servicing cannot exceed 50% of documented gross monthly family income.
- **Electric Vehicle (EV) Financing**: Up to 80% LTV financed by banks under green energy monetary concessions.
- **Internal Combustion (Petrol/Diesel) Car Financing**: Capped at 50% LTV.
- **Residential Home Loan LTV**: 70% LTV for first home; 50% LTV inside Kathmandu Valley for second property.

## 4. Tribhuvan International Airport (TIA) Customs Baggage Order (झिटिगुन्टा आदेश)
- Canonical URL: https://nepalicalc.com/customs/airport-baggage
- Regulatory Authority: Department of Customs, Ministry of Finance, Government of Nepal

### Personal Baggage Duty-Free Exemptions & Excess Slabs:
1. **Gold Jewelry (Finished Ornaments)**:
   - Female Travelers: Up to 50 grams 100% duty-free.
   - Male Travelers: Up to 25 grams 100% duty-free.
   - Next 50 grams excess: Taxable at ~NPR 9,500 per 10 grams (NPR 950/gram).
   - Above 100g total jewelry: Liable to confiscation and commercial penalty under the Customs Act.
2. **Raw Gold / Bullion / 24K Coins**:
   - 0 grams duty-free allowance.
   - Max 100 grams allowed with customs duty (first 50g @ NPR 9,500/10g; next 50g @ NPR 10,500/10g).
   - >100 grams raw gold is strictly prohibited and subject to seizure.
3. **Mobile Phones (Smartphones)**:
   - 1 phone 100% duty-free for general travelers.
   - 2 phones 100% duty-free for Nepali returnees who worked abroad for 6+ consecutive months on a valid labor permit (श्रम स्वीकृति).
   - Additional phones incur a flat ~NPR 10,000 customs duty and require MDMS registration.
4. **Television (TV)**:
   - 1 LED/Smart TV up to 32 inches is 100% duty-free for returnees with 12+ months foreign employment permit.
   - Non-labor or TVs > 32 inches pay customs duty based on screen size (NPR 4,500 to 28,000).
5. **Alcohol & Liquor**:
   - Strictly 1 bottle (maximum 1,000ml / 1 Liter) duty-free.
   - Carrying > 1 Liter in personal luggage is prohibited and confiscated at the arrival gate.
6. **Cash Foreign Currency**:
   - Up to USD 5,000 (or equivalent foreign currency) allowed without declaration. Amounts over USD 5,000 MUST be declared at the Red Channel.

---

## 5. Vehicle Bluebook Tax & Overdue Fines
- Canonical URL: https://nepalicalc.com/vehicle
- Jurisdiction: Province Transport Management Acts (Bagmati Province standards)

### Motorcycle / Scooter Annual Road Tax:
- Up to 125cc: NPR 3,000
- 126cc to 160cc: NPR 4,500
- 161cc to 250cc: NPR 6,000
- 251cc to 400cc: NPR 11,000
- 401cc and above: NPR 20,000

### Four-Wheeler (Car / Jeep / Van) Annual Tax:
- Up to 1000cc: NPR 22,000
- 1001cc to 1500cc: NPR 25,000
- 1501cc to 2000cc: NPR 33,000
- 2001cc to 2500cc: NPR 37,000
- 2501cc to 2900cc: NPR 45,000
- 2901cc and above: NPR 65,000

### Penalty Structure for Expired Bluebooks:
- 0 to 90 days from expiry date: 0% penalty (Grace period)
- 91 to 120 days: 5% fine on annual tax
- 121 to 165 days: 10% fine on annual tax
- 166 days to end of fiscal year (Ashadh end): 20% fine
- 1 to 5 years overdue: 100% fine on past years plus 32% compound transport fine.
